reason: An interactive Plan Graph plugin visualizes session messages and tool calls, with node details, filtering, favorites, and navigation back to conversation rows.

summaries.zh: 在会话视图中以交互式流程图展示消息和工具调用，并提供节点详情、筛选、收藏及定位到对话区等功能。
summaries.en: An interactive session graph that visualizes messages and tool calls with node details, filtering, favorites, and links back to conversation rows.

capabilities: Renders an interactive graph of session messages and tool calls
Reads the conversation snapshot to map graph nodes to chat rows
Persists per-session favorites in browser localStorage
Executes a prepare script during package installation to generate the client bundle
